description: Land Acquisition - Kotapola, Kotapola D/S Division, Matara District ; Pitipana-East, Chillow D/S Division, Puttalam District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2079/5, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including descriptions of properties, boundaries, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the "Land and property-related matters" category, specifically land acquisitions as defined for Type 4 classification.
